implementation: CSS normal is an explicit prepared natural-height operation that clears an inherited unitless ratio. Selected semantic height is emitted through stock platform reset behavior; ordinary native props, explicit zero, native overrides, source restoration and font-scaling options remain distinct. Extended operations are gated by the exact v2 native capability.

retainedSelectorReplay.qualification: Independent stage/mode bars and row fills qualify groups before comparisons. Fixed core Text controls are created inside opaque Glyph. Native receipts bind retained actual root/Text tags, one memoized row render, counters, line-event identity/freshness and disjoint glyph windows. Pixel checks cover glyph size and root height. Natural line-box metrics are endpoint assertions, not transient line-box pixel reconstruction.

stages: withdraw normal and inherit the 96-point parent height
ordinaryResetAndScaling.qualification: Each opaque Pair creates an independent core Text control outside its source provider. The row uses flex-start alignment so a source cannot stretch its control. Bound native line events and intrinsic frames must agree, refs attach once with no cleanup, tags remain unique/retained and revisions advance. Cross-profile controls independently distinguish scaled, capped and unscaled observations.

remainingLimits: Android natural-height runtime verification; source/float-model controls are separate
